bias.label: Leaning down below 4,000; testing today's low

event: US PPI on Fri 13 Nov (time UNVERIFIED, likely 15:30 SAST). Asia opens overnight; no confirmed high-impact US release before then.

bullets.title: Below 4,000
bullets.text: Gold was 3,983.90 at 23:33 SAST, down 47.90 (-1.19%), near today's low of 3,981.70 after a high of 4,067.90 (Kitco).

bullets.title: Round number lost
bullets.text: The 4,000 level that Kitco called solid support earlier has now broken, and Kitco says analysts warn of more losses toward 3,900.

bullets.title: Dollar at highs
bullets.text: The dollar index is up 0.69% near 102.94, its highest since April 2025, and the US 10-year yield is near 4.99% (Trading Economics).

bullets.title: Hike odds jump
bullets.text: Trading Economics says December hike odds rose to as high as 100%, with Waller floating 50 bp, though another report says 84.5% (sources differ, UNVERIFIED).

bullets.title: Hawkish Fed chorus
bullets.text: Logan, Paulson and Bowman also sounded hawkish, with Bowman saying inflation is broadening (Yahoo Finance, Trading Economics).

bullets.title: Hot CPI backdrop
bullets.text: October CPI rose 0.4% m/m against 0.3% expected, and core was 0.3% against 0.2%, which started this week's selling (Trading Economics).
